probes.name: default
probes.macro:
Public Enum Colour
Red
Blue = 5
End Enum
Public Type Holder
B As Byte
C As Colour
End Type
Function Probe() As String
Dim c As Colour
Probe = TypeName(c) & "|" & VarType(c) & "|" & c
End Function
Function Pick(ByVal c As Colour) As Colour
Pick = c + 1
End Function
Sub Bump(ByRef c As Colour)
c = c + 1
End Sub
